intro.text: These Terms & Conditions govern the booking and use of travel, trekking, adventure, outdoor learning, expedition and related services offered by Rock Lizard Adventure (hereinafter referred to as “Rock Lizard Adventure”, “we”, “us” or “our”).

The person booking or participating in our services shall hereinafter be referred to as “you”, “the Client” or “the Participant”. Rock Lizard Adventure and the Client shall collectively be referred to as the “Parties”.

By making a booking, paying a booking amount, participating in a trip, or using our website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agreed to these Terms & Conditions. These terms also apply to all participants included in a booking made by you, subject to applicable law.
Please read these Terms & Conditions carefully before confirming any booking.

sections.heading: 1. Paying for a Trek / Adventure Activity

blocks.text: The purchase of any travel or adventure service offered by Rock Lizard Adventure constitutes a contractual arrangement between Rock Lizard Adventure and the Client.

Trekking, mountaineering, camping, motorcycle expeditions, outdoor activities and travel in remote or high-altitude Himalayan regions involve inherent risks to life, health and property. These risks may include sudden weather changes, difficult terrain, altitude-related illness, road conditions, landslides, snow, river crossings, wildlife encounters, accidents and other unforeseen events.

Rock Lizard Adventure takes reasonable precautions and makes efforts to reduce risks through appropriate planning, trained personnel, equipment, safety procedures and operational decisions. However, the nature of adventure travel means that all risks cannot be eliminated.

By booking a trip or activity, you acknowledge these inherent risks and agree to comply with the safety instructions and operational guidelines issued by Rock Lizard Adventure and its designated team members.

Photographs, videos, graphics and other promotional materials displayed on our website, social media platforms, brochures or other marketing channels are intended for illustrative and promotional purposes.
Such images do not guarantee that you will experience, encounter or view the exact landscapes, weather conditions, wildlife, accommodation, facilities or activities depicted.
Actual experiences may vary depending on the season, weather, local conditions, itinerary changes and other circumstances beyond our control.

Rock Lizard Adventure offers trips and activities requiring varying levels of physical fitness, endurance and mental preparedness. The difficulty of an activity may depend on altitude, terrain, distance, duration, weather, climate and the nature of the activity.
It is your responsibility to carefully review the trip description, difficulty level, itinerary, fitness requirements and equipment recommendations before making a booking.
You are responsible for:

items: Maintaining an appropriate level of physical and mental fitness for the selected activity.
Obtaining medical advice before participating, wherever necessary.
Informing Rock Lizard Adventure of any relevant medical condition, disability, injury, pregnancy or health concern that may affect your safety or participation.
Carrying prescribed medication and necessary personal medical supplies.
Bringing suitable clothing, footwear, equipment and personal essentials as recommended.

blocks.text: Rock Lizard Adventure is not a medical service provider. Our team may not be able to provide advanced medical treatment in remote areas.

We reserve the right, based on reasonable safety considerations, to decline participation or remove a participant from an activity if their condition may create a risk to themselves or others. Any additional expenses arising from such circumstances shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable booking and cancellation policy and the law.
Failure to disclose relevant medical information may affect your ability to participate safely and may result in restrictions or termination of participation.
You are responsible for verifying the programme dates, departure and arrival timings, meeting points, duration and other details mentioned in the booking confirmation or travel documents.
Participants are expected to arrive at the designated meeting point on time.
Delays caused by late arrival, missed transport, personal reasons or failure to follow the communicated schedule may result in missed services or additional expenses.
Participants must carry all necessary identification documents, permits, certificates and other paperwork required for the trip or activity.
Depending on the destination, these may include:

items: Government-issued photo identification.
Passport or visa, where applicable.
Inner Line Permits or other restricted-area permits.
Medical certificates or fitness declarations, where required.
Any other documents requested by local authorities or the activity organiser.

blocks.text: Rock Lizard Adventure may assist with the permit process wherever included in the trip package. However, approval and issuance of permits remain subject to the relevant authorities.
Rock Lizard Adventure shall not be responsible for delays, denial of entry or missed services caused by missing, incorrect, expired or insufficient documents supplied by the participant.
Rock Lizard Adventure prioritises the safety and well-being of participants during all trips and activities.
We reserve the right to modify, postpone, shorten, extend, reroute or cancel any trip or part of an itinerary due to circumstances including, but not limited to:

items: Adverse weather conditions.
Heavy snowfall, rainfall, landslides or road blockages.
Natural disasters or other Acts of God.
Government restrictions, permit issues or local authority instructions.
Political unrest, strikes or security concerns.
Transportation delays, cancellations or breakdowns.
Accidents, illness or emergencies.
Insufficient operational feasibility.
Any other circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

blocks.text: The itinerary may also be modified by the designated trip leader or operations team when necessary for the safety of the group.
Where possible, participants will be informed of any significant changes in advance or during the trip.
Any additional expenses arising from itinerary changes shall be communicated to the participants and handled according to the applicable booking terms, cancellation policy and law.
The completion of a particular summit, pass, destination or activity cannot be guaranteed where conditions are unsafe or operationally unfeasible.
A booking shall be considered confirmed only after the required booking amount or payment has been received and confirmation has been issued by Rock Lizard Adventure.
Payment schedules, package prices, inclusions, exclusions and applicable taxes, if any, shall be communicated at the time of booking.
Participants are responsible for making payments within the stipulated timelines.
Failure to complete the required payment may result in cancellation of the booking, subject to the applicable cancellation policy.
Any additional services requested by the participant that are not included in the original package may be charged separately.
All cancellations, refunds, rescheduling requests and booking modifications shall be governed by the specific cancellation and refund policy communicated at the time of booking.
The applicable cancellation policy may vary depending on the trip, departure date, accommodation arrangements, permits, transportation bookings and other operational commitments.

No refund shall be assumed for services voluntarily left unused by a participant after the trip has commenced, except where required by applicable law or expressly provided under the relevant booking policy.

If Rock Lizard Adventure cancels a trip due to unforeseen circumstances, we may communicate available alternatives, such as rescheduling or an alternative programme, subject to availability and the applicable refund policy.
Any refund, rescheduling, credit or voucher shall be handled according to the specific terms communicated for that booking and applicable law.

Rock Lizard Adventure shall not be responsible for independent travel arrangements made by participants, including flights, trains, accommodation, visas or other personal bookings, except where liability is imposed by applicable law.
Please refer to the separate Cancellation & Refund Policy for detailed cancellation timelines, refund percentages and applicable charges.

All official booking-related communication shall be made through the contact details provided by the participant, including email, telephone, WhatsApp or other communication channels specified by Rock Lizard Adventure.
Participants are responsible for providing accurate and updated contact information.
Rock Lizard Adventure shall not be responsible for communication delays arising from incorrect contact details, network issues, unavailable devices or failure to check communicated updates.
Any change in contact details must be communicated to Rock Lizard Adventure as soon as possible.
Participants are responsible for their personal belongings, baggage, equipment, valuables, documents, cash, electronic devices and other possessions throughout the trip.
Rock Lizard Adventure recommends that participants carry only essential luggage and use appropriate protective packing.
We shall not be responsible for the loss, theft or damage of personal belongings except where liability arises under applicable law or due to our legally established responsibility.
Participants are responsible for ensuring that their luggage is suitable for the activity and does not exceed the communicated weight or size limits.
Participants are expected to behave respectfully and responsibly towards fellow participants, trip leaders, guides, local communities, service providers, wildlife and the natural environment.
The following behaviours are not acceptable:

items: Disrespectful, abusive, threatening or discriminatory conduct.
Harassment or inappropriate behaviour towards any participant or team member.
Consumption or possession of prohibited substances in violation of applicable law or programme rules.
Deliberate disregard of safety instructions.
Damage to property, equipment, campsites or the environment.
Behaviour that endangers the participant, the group or any other person.

blocks.text: Rock Lizard Adventure reserves the right to restrict or terminate a participant’s involvement in a trip or activity where their conduct creates a safety concern or materially disrupts the programme.
The decision of the designated trip leader regarding immediate safety matters shall be followed by all participants.

Any termination of participation shall be handled in accordance with the applicable booking terms and law. Additional expenses arising from such termination may be the participant’s responsibility where legally permissible.
The trip leader, trek leader, guide or designated activity coordinator appointed by Rock Lizard Adventure shall be responsible for managing the activity and making operational decisions.
Participants agree to follow reasonable instructions regarding:

items: Route selection and movement.
Safety procedures and equipment.
Group discipline and timing.
Weather-related decisions.
Emergency response and evacuation.
Campsite and accommodation arrangements.
Any other matter affecting the safety or well-being of the group.

blocks.text: The trip leader may modify or discontinue an activity when conditions become unsafe or unsuitable.
No participant shall be entitled to insist on continuing an activity against the reasonable safety decision of the designated leader.
Rock Lizard Adventure operates in diverse geographical locations, including remote Himalayan regions where facilities may be basic or limited.
Accommodation, sanitation, electricity, mobile network connectivity, internet access, medical facilities, transportation and other amenities may differ from those available in urban areas.
Participants are requested to understand and accept the nature of remote travel and remain prepared for reasonable compromises.
Facilities shall be provided as specified in the relevant trip itinerary or package description.
The inclusions and exclusions of each trip shall be clearly mentioned in the itinerary, package description or booking confirmation.
Depending on the package, inclusions may consist of:

items: Accommodation.
Meals.
Transportation.
Trek or activity leaders and guides.
Permits and entry fees.
Camping equipment.
Local logistics and support.
Other services expressly mentioned in the package.

blocks.text: Unless specifically included, the following may be considered additional expenses:

items: Personal travel to and from the trip starting or ending point.
Insurance.
Personal medical expenses.
Emergency evacuation or rescue expenses.
Personal equipment and clothing.
Additional accommodation or meals.
Tips and gratuities.
Laundry, phone calls, beverages and personal purchases.
Expenses resulting from delays, extensions or itinerary changes.
Any optional activity or service not included in the package.

blocks.text: Participants are responsible for reviewing the inclusions and exclusions before confirming a booking.
Adventure travel and outdoor activities involve inherent risks that may not be entirely avoidable despite reasonable precautions.

These risks may include physical injury, altitude-related illness, slips and falls, difficult terrain, extreme weather, road accidents, wildlife encounters, natural hazards and limited access to medical facilities.
By booking or participating in an adventure activity, you acknowledge that you have been informed of the general nature of these risks and agree to participate responsibly.
Nothing in these Terms & Conditions shall exclude or limit any liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited under applicable law.
Participants are advised to obtain suitable travel, medical and adventure activity insurance wherever available and appropriate for the selected activity.

In case of illness, injury, accident or any emergency during a trip, Rock Lizard Adventure and its team may take reasonable steps to arrange assistance, including contacting local medical services, arranging transportation or coordinating evacuation where feasible.

Participants acknowledge that medical assistance, rescue and evacuation may be delayed or limited in remote and high-altitude regions due to weather, terrain, connectivity, accessibility or availability of resources.

The participant shall be responsible for medical, hospital, evacuation, transportation, repatriation and other expenses incurred on their behalf, to the extent not covered by insurance or otherwise required by applicable law.
Rock Lizard Adventure does not guarantee the availability, speed or outcome of emergency medical or rescue services.

Rock Lizard Adventure may engage third-party service providers to deliver certain services, including transportation operators, hotels, guesthouses, homestays, restaurants, local guides, equipment providers, porters, pony handlers, medical providers and other local partners.
These providers may operate independently and may be subject to their own terms, conditions and operational procedures.

Rock Lizard Adventure makes reasonable efforts to coordinate with suitable service providers. However, services delivered by independent providers may be affected by circumstances beyond our reasonable control.
Nothing in this clause shall exclude or limit any liability of Rock Lizard Adventure that may arise under applicable law.
Photographs and videos may be taken during trips, treks, expeditions and outdoor programmes for documentation, memories or promotional purposes.

Rock Lizard Adventure may use photographs or videos for promotional purposes, including its website, social media platforms, brochures and marketing materials, subject to applicable law and the participant’s consent wherever required.
Participants who do not wish to be featured in promotional photographs or videos may communicate their preference to Rock Lizard Adventure before or during the activity.
We shall make reasonable efforts to respect such requests.
For programmes involving children, photographs and videos intended for promotional use shall be handled with appropriate consent from parents or legal guardians.

Participants may also share photographs or videos with Rock Lizard Adventure. Sharing such material does not automatically grant permission for public or promotional use unless the necessary consent has been obtained.
Any optional activity or service not expressly included in the confirmed itinerary or package shall be considered separate from the booked programme.
Where such activities are conducted by independent providers, participation may be subject to the provider’s own terms, safety requirements and charges.
Rock Lizard Adventure may assist with coordination or information regarding optional activities, but such assistance does not automatically make us the operator of those activities.
Participants must independently review the risks, requirements and terms applicable to any optional activity.
Rock Lizard Adventure may organise outdoor learning, experiential education, trekking, camping and adventure programmes for children, students and school groups.
For such programmes:

items: Parents or legal guardians and/or the authorised institution must provide the required consent and participant information.
Relevant medical conditions, allergies, medication requirements and special needs must be disclosed in advance.
Participants must follow the instructions of the designated educators, instructors and programme leaders.
Safety, group discipline and age-appropriate participation shall be prioritised.
Participation may be restricted where a safety concern arises.
Photography or videography for promotional purposes shall be subject to appropriate consent.

blocks.text: Schools, institutions, parents and guardians are responsible for ensuring that the information supplied for participants is accurate and complete.
Additional programme-specific terms may apply and shall be communicated before participation.

Rock Lizard Adventure may provide ground support, logistics, accommodation, transportation, trekking operations, guides, outdoor activities and related services to travel agencies, tour operators, schools, institutions and other organisations.

The booking agency or institutional client shall be responsible for communicating relevant trip information, requirements, inclusions, exclusions and applicable terms to its participants.

Any special operational, commercial or cancellation terms agreed in writing between Rock Lizard Adventure and the booking agency or institution shall take precedence over general terms to the extent of any inconsistency, subject to applicable law.

We make reasonable efforts to keep website information accurate and updated. However, itineraries, prices, availability, descriptions, photographs and other information may change due to operational or other circumstances.
Website content does not constitute a guarantee of availability or of a particular experience unless expressly confirmed in writing.

The collection, use, storage and sharing of personal information shall be governed by our Privacy Policy, which forms part of the terms applicable to the use of our services.

At Rock Lizard Adventure, your trust is as important to us as the experiences we create in the mountains.

We are committed to respecting your privacy and protecting the personal information you share with us while exploring our website, enquiring about our adventures, booking our services, or participating in our trekking and outdoor programs.
This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, when it may be shared, and how we work to keep it secure.
By using our website or engaging with our services, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy, subject to applicable laws.

items: Full name
Email address
Mobile number
Age or date of birth
City, state, and country of residence
Emergency contact details

blocks.text: B. Booking & Travel Information

blocks.text: C. Health & Safety Information

Allergies

blocks.text: This information is collected only when reasonably necessary for participant safety, trip planning, or emergency management.
D. Children's Information

Such information may include the child's name, age, emergency contact details, and relevant health or safety information.

blocks.text: We collect and use personal information only for purposes that are relevant to the services we provide.

intro.text: At Rock Lizard Adventure, we understand that unexpected circumstances may arise and affect your travel plans. However, planning and organising treks, expeditions and adventure activities involves advance bookings and operational arrangements.
To ensure transparency and clarity, the following Cancellation & Refund Policy applies to all bookings made with Rock Lizard Adventure.

blocks.text: If you wish to cancel your booking, the following cancellation charges shall apply based on the number of days remaining before the scheduled departure date:

rows: Cancellation 30 days or more before departure
Cancellation between 29 and 16 days before departure
Cancellation 15 days or less before departure

blocks.text: Note: The cancellation period shall be calculated based on the scheduled departure date of the trip.
All cancellation requests must be submitted in writing through our official email address or the communication channel used for the booking.
The cancellation request shall be considered effective from the date and time it is received and acknowledged by Rock Lizard Adventure.
Participants are advised to ensure that they receive written confirmation of their cancellation.
Eligible refunds shall be processed through the original payment method, wherever possible.
The time required for the refund to reflect in the participant’s bank account or payment method may depend on the bank, payment gateway or financial institution.
Any applicable transaction or processing charges, if relevant, shall be handled in accordance with the terms communicated at the time of booking and applicable law.
No refund shall be provided for any participant who voluntarily withdraws from, leaves or discontinues a trip after it has commenced.

No refund shall be provided for unused services, including accommodation, meals, transportation, permits or other services included in the package, except where required under applicable law or expressly agreed by Rock Lizard Adventure.

Rock Lizard Adventure reserves the right to cancel, postpone or modify a trip due to unforeseen circumstances, including adverse weather conditions, natural disasters, road blockages, government restrictions, safety concerns or other operational reasons beyond our reasonable control.
In such cases, participants shall be informed of the available options in accordance with the applicable booking terms and law.

items: Cancellation charges apply to the total trip booking amount.
Refund eligibility is determined by the cancellation period applicable to the scheduled departure date.
Participants are encouraged to review the itinerary and booking details carefully before confirming their reservation.
This policy should be read together with the Terms & Conditions and the specific booking details provided by Rock Lizard Adventure.

blocks.text: For cancellation requests or refund-related queries, please contact us through our official communication channels.
